The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Supply, Installation, Testing & Commissioning of Blue Star Air Conditioners through GeM 1. Scope of Supply The bidder shall supply, install, test and commission genuine Blue Star Air Conditioners, along with all nece ssary accessories, fittings and installation materials, as specified in the GeM Bid. 2. Make and Brand • The offered air conditioner shall be of Top 5 IDC Brands. • The product must be brand new, unused and of the latest available manufacturing series.

• Refurbished, reconditioned or second-hand products shall not be accepted. • The bidder shall submit valid OEM authorization wherever required. 3. Technical Specifications • The AC shall comply with the technical specifications mentioned in the GeM Bid. • The equipment shall have the required cooling capacity, energy efficiency rating, inverter technology an d other features as specified. • The product shall comply with applicable BEE energy-efficiency standards. • The bidder shall submit the technical datasheet/catalogue of the offered model. • Any deviation from the prescribed technical specifications shall be clearly indicated. 4. Installation and Commissioning • The successful bidder shall be responsible for installation, testing and commissioning of the air condition ers at the consignee's location. • All standard installation accessories, including copper piping, insulation, drain pipe, communication cabl e, mounting brackets and other necessary materials, shall be provided as per the scope of supply. • Installation shall be carried out by trained and authorized technicians. • The bidder shall ensure proper cooling performance and satisfactory operation after installation. • Installation and commissioning shall be completed within the delivery period specified in the GeM Contra ct. 5. Warranty • The product shall carry a minimum comprehensive warranty of 1 year from the date of successful install ation and commissioning. • Compressor warranty shall be as per the applicable Blue Star OEM warranty policy or the higher warrant y period specified in the bid. • Warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and replacement/repair of defective components as per OEM warranty terms. • No additional charges shall be payable for warranty service covered under the contract. 6. After-Sales Service • The bidder shall provide prompt after-sales service through OEM authorized service centres. • Service complaints shall be attended to within 48 hours of registration. • The bidder shall provide OEM customer care and service escalation details. • The bidder shall ensure availability of genuine spare parts during the warranty period. 7. Documents to be Submitted The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the technical bid: 1. Technical compliance sheet against the prescribed specifications. 2. Product catalogue/datasheet of the offered Blue Star AC model. 3. Valid OEM authorization, wherever applicable. 4. GST registration certificate. 5. PAN card of the bidder. 6. Declaration confirming that the offered products are genuine and brand new.

7. Details of authorized service centres and customer support. 8. Applicable BEE rating/energy-efficiency details. 8. Delivery and Installation Period The complete supply, installation and commissioning shall be completed within the delivery period stipulat ed in the GeM Contract. 9. Inspection and Acceptance • The consignee shall inspect the supplied equipment for conformity with the specifications. • Any defective, damaged or non-compliant equipment shall be replaced by the successful bidder without additional cost. • Final acceptance shall be subject to successful installation, commissioning and satisfactory performance. 10. Payment Terms Payment shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) and the terms spe cified in the GeM Contract, subject to successful delivery and acceptance. 11. pre-Bid Meeting & Site Survey: A Pre-Bid Meeting & Site Survey shall conduct as per schedule mention ed in the GEM bid at Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose State Police Academy, Chandkhuri, Raipur. bidders are required to visit, inspect, and thoroughly examine the project site to familiarize themselves with the of wor k, existing infrastructure, site conditions, and all other factors that may affect the execution of the project before submission of their bids. Attendance at both the Pre-Bid Meeting & the Site Survey shall mandatory. The bidder shall attend the Pre-Bid Meeting and Site Visit, either by the bidder itself or through its authoriz ed representative. The authorized representative shall carry an authorization letter issued by the bidder a nd submit the same at the time of attendance. Any bid submitted by a bidder who fails to attend either the Pre-Bid Meeting or the Site- Visit, or fails to upload the duly signed Pre-Bid Meeting & Site Visit Certificate a long with the bid on the Gem portal, shall considered non-responsive and shall be rejected 12. SECURITY DEPOSIT A) Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The Bidder shall submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of 10,000 (Rup ees Ten Thousand only) in the form of a Demand Draft (DD) or Bank Guarantee issued by a Scheduled Nati onalised/Commercial Bank in favour of Director Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose State Police Academy, Chan dkhuri, Raipur A scanned COPY of the EMD instrument shall be uploaded along with the bid. The original E MD instrument shall submitted to the University within four (4) days from the date of bid closing date. Bids not accompanied by the prescribed EMD, or for which the original Demand Draft is not received within the stipulated time, shall be liable to rejected. No exemption shall be permitted to any bidder, including MSEs, MSMEs, Startups, or any other entities. 13. General Conditions • All applicable taxes and duties shall be as per the GeM Contract. • The bidder shall comply with all applicable statutory requirements. • The bidder shall be responsible for any damage caused during transportation, handling or installation. • In case of any discrepancy, the GeM Bid conditions and applicable GeM GTC shall prevail. • The buyer reserves the right to reject any product that does not meet the prescribed technical specificati ons. Note: The bidder shall ensure complete compliance with the above-mentioned terms and conditions before submission of the bid. .
